name: YouTube

steps.note: focuses the search box at the top of the page
opens the results page; choosing a video title plays it

tips: Player shortcuts need focus on the player: in the current desktop layout, click the video player once before using them. Letters typed while the search box is focused are text.
Left/Right (5 s), Up/Down (volume 5%) and Home/End (start/end of the video) are documented for when the seek bar has focus. j, l, m, k and the digits are documented for the player as a whole.
Space plays or pauses only when the seek bar is selected; if a button has focus, Space activates that button. k toggles play/pause in the player.
The frame-step keys , and . work only while the video is paused.
shift+p works only inside a playlist. shift+n goes to the next playlist item or, outside a playlist, to the next suggested video.
f toggles full screen and Escape also leaves it. c toggles captions only when the video has them.
Chapter keys differ by OS: Ctrl with Left/Right on Windows, Option with Left/Right on Mac.
? (or the profile picture menu > Keyboard shortcuts) shows the full list. Hovering a player button also shows its key.
